$comment: Value types: what a value is and how it is written. Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. A type says nothing about secrecy (protection belongs to the property) and nothing about meaning (the property's name and description do). One type, one kind of value: a web address, a generic URI, a bare contact identifier and a contact URI are four different types.

web_url.description: A web address: an http or https URL. A local admin page such as http://192.168.1.1/ is one.

uri.description: Any URI: a scheme, a colon and the rest, such as ssh://host, otpauth://totp/x or urn:isbn:0451450523. Use web_url when it must be a web address.

email_address.description: A bare e-mail address, such as user@example.org. Not a mailto: URI.

phone_number.description: A bare phone number: digits with the usual separators, an optional leading +. Not a tel: URI.

tel_uri.description: A phone number as a tel: URI (RFC 3966), such as tel:+49-30-1234567.

sms_uri.description: A phone number to text, as an sms: URI (RFC 5724), such as sms:+15105550101 or sms:+15105550101?body=hello.

mailto_uri.description: An e-mail address as a mailto: URI, such as mailto:user@example.org.

otp.description: The secret of a one-time password (TOTP or HOTP): the key as base32 text, or an otpauth:// address.

card_number.description: A payment card number: 13 to 23 digits, spaces allowed.

cvv.description: A card security code: 3 or 4 digits.

iban.description: An international bank account number: country code, two check digits, the account part. Printed in groups of four with spaces; the spaces are allowed.

mac.description: A network hardware (MAC) address: six pairs of hex digits, separated by colons. A dash is also read.

wifi_security.description: How a Wi-Fi network is secured, as a router's settings page names it. wpa2-wpa3 is the mixed mode a router offers while devices move from WPA2 to WPA3.
